description: List the authenticated user's tracked job applications with their pipeline stage (applied / phone_screen / interview / offer / rejected / withdrawn), newest first — the read companion to `track_application`. Use when the user asks 'what's in my pipeline?', 'where did I apply?', or before moving an application to a new stage. Not for the saved/bookmarked list — use `list_saved_jobs` for that.

limit.description: Max entries to return (1-100, default 50, newest first).

name: list_applications

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: The user's tracked applications with pipeline stage

domain.description: Company domain — pairs with jobId for get_job / match_job / save_job / track_application

jobId.description: Canonical job id in the same form the write tools accept

listingExpired.description: Present (true) when the posting is past its validThrough

listingRemoved.description: Present (true) when the posting is no longer in the index

total.description: Total entries on the user's list

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: List Applications
